props.name: visual
props.description: Product shot or illustration. With `align="start"` it sits beside the text on wide screens.

props.name: label
props.description: e.g. "Trusted by 2,000+ teams".

props.name: scroll
props.description: Scroll the logos sideways (pauses on hover and focus). Off: a wrapped row.

props.name: bottom
props.description: Copyright and legal links.

props.name: tagline
props.description: A line under the logo.

props.name: tools
props.description: Tools or integrations scrolling in a strip above the columns.

props.name: actions
props.description: Sign in / Get started.

props.name: country
props.description: Current country code.

props.name: items
props.description: Top-level links; an item with `items` opens a mega-menu, one with `columns` a grouped mega-menu.

props.name: logo
props.description: e.g. <Logo />, wrapped in a link to `logoHref`.

props.name: logoLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the logo link. Defaults to the logo's own name; set it only if it still contains the visible wordmark.

props.name: billingLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the billing switch.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code.

props.name: perMonthLabel
props.description: Shown after each price.

props.name: accent
props.description: App or division accent for the card.

props.name: division
props.description: The card's division: sets `data-division` and, without `accent`, tints the card.

props.name: icon
props.description: Product mark, e.g. <PayubMark size={24} />.

props.name: division
props.description: Sets `data-division`: everything inside takes the division's accent (needs `@nexub/themes/divisions`).

props.name: division
props.description: Sets `data-division`: the eyebrow takes the division's colour (needs `@nexub/themes/divisions`).

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A string becomes a gradient EyebrowChip.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading above the stats (h2).

props.name: prefix
props.description: Shown before / after the number, e.g. "$" or "+".

props.name: value
props.description: A number counts up when it scrolls into view; a string shows as is.

props.name: accent
props.description: The product the customer uses: a coloured top edge and tint.

props.name: rating
props.description: Stars out of 5.

props.name: header
props.description: A SectionHeader, usually.
